note: Sprint 4 evaluation set: 20 questions (10 EN + 10 AR). expected_documents is the list of documents whose chunk holds the authoritative answer (a question may be answered correctly from either of two docs, e.g. KYC vs Account Opening). expected_phrase is a short phrase from the SOURCE document (logical text) that a correct answer should contain — it is a check on the answer, not on the retrieval. expected_page is the page of the chunk that holds the answer (from data/chunks.jsonl). The set is FIXED: do not change questions or phrases to make scores pass.
